seo.title: Atlassian Rovo AI Services | M20 Technology
seo.description: Unlock enterprise knowledge with Atlassian Rovo: AI search, chat, and agents across your apps. M20 helps you plan, extend, and roll out Rovo.

hero.title: Unlock enterprise knowledge with Rovo.
hero.intro: Powered by generative AI to help teams make better decisions and reach their goals faster — finding information across every SaaS app, learning as they work, and acting with virtual agents.

cards.label: Find
cards.title: Search once, find every answer.
cards.text: Ask a question in plain language and Rovo searches every connected app to bring back the answer.

cards.label: Learn
cards.title: Have an intelligent conversation.
cards.text: Rovo chats through your knowledge base, connecting the dots across Confluence, Jira, and beyond.

cards.label: Act
cards.title: Meet your new AI teammates.
cards.text: Rovo agents take on tasks — drafting content, updating tickets, and more — so your team can focus on the work only they can do.

cards.title: Create and review agents
cards.text: Generate, review and refine content for all types of communications, product specs, goal setting and more.

cards.title: Workflow management agents
cards.text: Automate and streamline tasks such as creating a draft design for new requests, or taking action when a Jira issue progresses.

cards.title: Knowledge management agents
cards.text: Answer questions, integrate research into Jira specs, create service checklists, or contribute to custom knowledge bases.

cards.title: Team culture agents
cards.text: Help with onboarding new employees, building team gratitude and facilitating team collaboration.

cards.title: Maintenance agents
cards.text: Streamline time-consuming tasks like cleaning up Jira backlogs, organizing Confluence pages, or aligning content to formatting specs.

cards.title: Custom agents
cards.text: Use Rovo Agents out-of-the-box, create your own with Rovo's no-code interface, or explore a wide variety of agents on the Atlassian Marketplace.

foundation.title: Built on the Atlassian Teamwork Graph.
foundation.text: Powered by Atlassian Intelligence and two decades of experience, the Teamwork Graph pulls data from your Atlassian tools and other SaaS apps — unlocking a comprehensive view of your goals, knowledge, teams, and work.

extend.title: The fastest way to extend Rovo.
extend.text: The Atlassian ecosystem has AI-powered agents and search connectors to help you extend Rovo to every team and industry.
extend.imageAlt: Rovo search connectors: Google Drive, SharePoint, Microsoft Teams, Figma, Slack, GitHub, Canva, draw.io, LaunchDarkly, Zephyr, UserTesting, Zapier

cta.title: For a closer look at Rovo and the possibilities of AI with your team, get in touch.
